note: BNU Timor's price list (in force from 12 October 2026, in US dollars and before any tax): a private customer's demand deposit account costs 2 dollars a month, charged on the 15th, and 0.30 when the average balance is 150 dollars or less, a lower rate below a figure that the game doesn't write, so the fee is charged in full.
